track/c-payment-sheet on main 869c7e5 (after e-reviews): edbbaad feat(sheet) read endpoint + contract; c53e178 feat(admin-ui) sheet screen. Not landed, not pushed.

Endpoint: GET /v1/admin/recording-sheet?month=YYYY-MM&fundId=&after=&limit= (contract packages/contracts/src/operations/recording-sheet.ts, RECORDING_SHEET_OPERATIONS, op listAdminRecordingSheet). Permission client_position.write or client_values.read (POSITION_READ_PERMISSIONS).

Rows: active admin SIP schedules whose range covers the month (start_month <= month < start + month_count), optional fund filter, across funds. Item: scheduleId,userId,clientName,clientEmail (tombstone-masked like reports),fundId,fundName,monthlyAmountPaise,startMonth,monthCount,recorded {entryId,amountPaise,effectiveDate,recordedAt}|null.
recorded = live month link (released_at null) joined to its client_value_entries row (principal_delta_paise). Reversed recordings show null.
Why a new endpoint, not a per-fund walk: the per-fund list gives only paidMonths names, not the recorded amount, and needs one walk per fund.

Wall: repo is repositories/monthlyRecordingSheetRepository.ts, route routes/adminRecordingSheetRoutes.ts (no sip/payment in the path), same as clientReceiptRepository joining the link to the ledger; schedule code still never reads the ledger; architecture guard unchanged.

Paging: order client full_name then schedule id; signed cursor carries only the schedule id, bound to month+fundId (CURSOR_INVALID on change), limit default 25 max 100. Same keyset shape as c-sip listByFund.
Registered in runtime/adminComposition.ts with readDeps (one line after audit-trail). composition.ts untouched (636).
Frontend: features/admin/payment-sheet/, route /client-values/payment-sheet (client_position.write), hub entry on /client-values, link-map entry. adminQueries.ts untouched (511).
Rows load via usePagedQuery loadAll (limit 100) over the new read; a failed page stops the walk and AsyncBoundary shows the error with retry.
Per row: tick Record, amount in rupees (defaults to schedule amount; parsePositiveRupees, >2 decimals or any other format refused, never rounded), date (defaults to IST today, future refused).
Recording: existing recordAdminClientContribution with reasonCode recorded_offline_monthly_investment + sipScheduleLink {scheduleId, month}. Confirm dialog shows rows and total.

Idempotency: useRecordingSheetRecorder mints a key per row on Record, stores {key,userId,body} in sessionStorage key beo.admin.recording-sheet.v1:<month>:<scheduleId>; inputs locked to the held body; Check again resends same key+body, also after reload; cleared only on success or an API refusal; unknown (timeout/5xx/IDEMPOTENCY_*) keeps it.

Concurrency: queue with MAX_IN_FLIGHT=2; chips Not sent/Pending/Sending/Recorded/Refused (server field error text)/Not confirmed. Recorded rows (local or server) are locked until Record another, which also resets the draft; the server refuses an already-paid month per row.
Expired idempotency receipt on a late Check again is still safe: the month link is unique, so the server refuses the duplicate with the sipScheduleLink.month field error.

CSV paste: lines of reference, amount, optional date (comma or tab, quotes honoured). Reference = schedule id, client id or client email (case-insensitive). Ambiguous client (several schedules), no match, bad amount/date, duplicate line, or a recorded/held row are listed per line; fills tick rows only; nothing sends until Record.
No bank reference/UTR anywhere (rule-11; question row 16 open). Plan C4 still mentions UTR and a migration; neither was built.

Checks (Node 22 container) on main 869c7e5: contracts check 98 tests, 170 ops reachable; backend check 100 files/1198; integration 55 files/507 (coverage off; new recordingSheet.integration.test.ts 4 tests); frontend check 34 files/311; build:admin and build:client with boot checks.

Negative controls: backend - no released filter, no range end, no permission check each failed one test. Frontend - new key on Check again, no sessionStorage, MAX_IN_FLIGHT 3, resend after success (gates removed), rounding/comma parser each failed the matching test.

Conservative defaults for plan 0a: rows default unticked so nothing records for clients who did not pay; client reference = email or id (no client reference field exists); held keys live per tab (sessionStorage), cleared when the tab closes.
Not done: plan doc/section 8 (coordinator), browser/device runs, VPS.
